title: EXHAUST SYSTEM
summary: Front exhaust pipes (exhaust 'Y'/head pipes, LH/RH) from the exhaust manifolds back past the transmission. At each manifold the pipe's flange is drawn up on the manifold studs with nuts, with an extension (ball/donut seat) and packing between; at the rear the pipes are hung by a U-bolt through a clamp, with lock washer and nut, from a clamp bracket at the transmission/engine rear mount. Sealer goes on the slip joint at the rear of the front pipe.

parts.name: CLAMP
parts.name_expanded: Clamp – lower saddle under the exhaust pipe for the U-bolt

parts.name: PACKING
parts.name_expanded: Packing – exhaust manifold to pipe seal (donut)

parts.name: CLAMP
parts.name_expanded: Clamp – exhaust pipe support bracket at transmission

materials.where: slip joint at the rear end of front pipe [5]

fastening.note: Packing [9] and extension [8] sit between the manifold outlet and the pipe [5]; flange [6] over the pipe is drawn up by nuts [7] on studs coming down from the manifold (the studs are part of the manifold, no callout). Note A: tighten nuts uniformly, 8 lbs. ft. minimum inspection torque after roll test.

fastening.to: clamp [10] at the transmission / engine rear mount
fastening.note: U-bolt [1] comes down from clamp bracket [10] around the pipe, through clamp [2] underneath; lock washer [3] and nut [4] from below.
Sealer 82a at the slip joint at the rear of the front pipe.

notes: Tighten nuts uniformly, to specified torque (8 lbs. ft. minimum inspection torque after roll test).
